Alex W: Quick heads up — Acme (Enterprise) wants to rebaseline their renewal. Current commit 2k tokens/mo, they want to move to 5k and add a 3-week POC on Dedicated. Asking for an uplift discount and a 90-day grace for overages.
Maria S: Got it. Do we know why they're asking for the grace?
Alex W: They said product team needs the POC to validate latency SLAs before committing to Dedicated. Also raised security questionnaire items about egress controls + SSO.
Kevin T: On the pricing side — standard rate card gives a 12% discount at 5k commit. They want an effective ~25% on first quarter to smooth cost during POC. Can we make a one-time uplift discount?
Linda (DealDesk): Please add rationale: ARR at risk, reference customer tier, and renewal date. DealDesk needs justification before any rate override. Also we need target margin impact number.
Alex W: Renewal date in 4 weeks. ARR $420k TCV. They threatened to test alternatives if latency isn't proven. They see this as strategic — flagship finserv customer.
Jorge - Solutions: For the POC we can run a 3-week Dedicated trial in us-west with limited telemetry and SAML SSO. We'll enable KV cache warmup and a 75ms 95th p99 gate for the test. Security: we can provide SOC2 report and an egress control plan (no external storage).
Maria S: Can legal approve a 30-day opt-out in the contract if POC fails? That reduces risk for them but increases churn risk for us.
Kevin T: If we allow opt-out, recommend making the uplift discount conditional: 15% baseline credit for the first 90 days; additional 10% subject to exec signoff if they provide case study / reference. That keeps downside limited.
Linda (DealDesk): Provisional approach: approve up to 15% one-time uplift discount for quarter 1 + 30-day opt-out, contingent on Solutions doc + SOC2 attestation. Anything >15% requires Revenue leader approval. Please attach the POC scope and customer success plan.
Alex W: Copying list for follow-ups. I'll upload POC scope today and ping Revenue.
DeployBot: [deploy-notice] POC environment requested: acme-poc-17672 — Dedicated trial queued (ETA 48h). Link: https://deploys.internal/acme-poc-17672
Jorge - Solutions: I'll draft the minimal POC SOW: ramp plan, dataset subset, latency SLA, success metrics. Will include SSO steps and egress controls.
Kevin T: I'll prepare a short financial justification and margin impact calc — need to know if we preserve overage pricing or waive for first 90 days.
Linda (DealDesk): Also add a short paragraph on long-term commit ask (12 months). We want to trade uplift discount for a 12-month committed contract.
Alex W: Perfect. I'll call the customer now. Thanks everyone — I'll update thread after the exec sync. :thumbsup:
